_comment: painlessMesh's capability catalog: what its HIL suite claims to prove, keyed
by the names its tests carry in @pytest.mark.capability(...). The report
renders one row per entry -- validated, failed, blocked, skipped, or
NOT VALIDATED when no test in the run provided evidence for it.
This lived inside alteriom_hil.report until the farm's second consumer ran
and received a report listing all thirty of these as coverage gaps for a
product that never claimed any of them. A catalog is a consumer's
statement about its own suite; the profile points at it (report.capabilities).
A key marked in a test but absent here is reported as undeclared rather than
dropped: node.reset_recovery had been marked and silently unreported.
artifact.provenance: Firmware reports the exact painlessMesh and HIL agent source commits under test
artifact.family_matrix: Every connected board uses the artifact mapped to its MCU family
mesh.formation: Every physical node joins one mesh and sees every peer
mesh.mixed_mcu: Different ESP32 MCU families interoperate in one mesh
mesh.unicast: Every node delivers unicast traffic to every other node
mesh.broadcast: Every node broadcasts successfully to every peer
mesh.payload_integrity: Structured, escaped, and large application payloads arrive byte-for-byte intact
mesh.bidirectional: Application data flows in both directions across every physical board pair
delivery.timeout: Delivery callbacks report a stalled receiver timeout
routing.unknown_node: An unroutable destination is rejected without a false ACK
priority.levels: Priority levels 0 through 3 preserve example behavior
gateway.bridge: A dedicated bridge joins upstream Wi-Fi and remains in the mesh
gateway.local_internet: A bridge reports Internet on its own uplink, not only through a peer
internet.self: A gateway relays its own request through its own uplink, with no mesh peer involved
internet.self.first_send: A bridge relays its own request within seconds of associating upstream, before its first periodic health probe has run
gateway.stale_after_reboot: A bridge that rebooted as a regular node answers relayed requests with an honest failure at once, instead of letting them time out while peers still trust it
internet.service_semantics: For a service whose HTTP status does not encode delivery, its status and its own words reach the application intact, so the application can judge delivery against the service's ledger
internet.provider.callmebot: A regular node's WhatsApp request reaches the real CallMeBot API through the mesh and is accepted, once; sent only for release builds on rigs configured to
internet.provider.callmebot.refusal: CallMeBot's real refusal of an invalid key reaches the application intact, once, and is never read as a delivery
internet.single_delivery: One sendToInternet() call reaches the destination once: a request that may have arrived (read timeout, any reply) is never resent
internet.retry_after: A 429 retry waits for the server's Retry-After and carries the same request id as the refused attempt
internet.transport_errors: Refused, unresolvable and timed-out destinations are reported as network errors, never as HTTP statuses
gateway.discovery: Regular nodes discover advertised Internet availability
internet.get: A regular node relays an HTTP GET through the bridge
internet.post: A regular node relays an HTTP POST payload through the bridge
internet.errors: HTTP and connectivity failures return honest results
internet.recovery: The Internet relay remains usable after an upstream request failure
gateway.failover: A backup gateway takes over after primary loss
gateway.shared: Shared-gateway election and routing operate on physical nodes
gateway.shared.mixed_mcu: Every attached MCU family can operate in shared-gateway mode
gateway.shared.internet: Every shared-gateway node reaches the controlled upstream endpoint
ota.mesh: Firmware is transferred and activated through the mesh OTA path
power.recovery: A genuine MCU power cut reboots and rejoins the node
node.reset_recovery: A node rebooted over EN rejoins the mesh and is routed to again; proves the mesh heals around a reboot, not that the rig survives re-enumeration
soak.stability: The mesh remains healthy during a sustained traffic soak
mesh.heap_stability: Free heap remains within the allowed bound during sustained traffic
delivery.ack.sustained: Acknowledged delivery remains lossless throughout the traffic soak
